decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the three Maricopa County Assessor parcels owned by Redale LLC, on which the City of Mesa has issued the Facebook/Meta MAZ campus permits (including the Meta MAZ7 Building 17 data storage building at 3841 S Ellsworth Rd), as the campus locator replacing the imported Mesa city reference point.
layer: Maricopa County Assessor Parcels MapServer layer 0, requested in WGS84 (outSR 4326)

facts.centroid_method: shapely 2.1.1 planar centroid of the union in WGS84 longitude/latitude, rounded to 7 decimals; the WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N (EPSG:32612) planar centroid transformed back with pyproj 3.7.1 differs by 0.02 m

exclusions: Neighbouring parcels owned by others (including Novva's parcel 304-31-141 west of Ellsworth Rd and the CyrusOne, EdgeCore and NTT holdings) are not part of the union. An earlier owner query with a LIKE pattern also matched an unrelated residential parcel held by a private trust; it is not used and its owner is not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport, city centre or industrial-area centroid is used.
